mentions.name: PageWatch
mentions.description: A tool that checks whether LLMs can understand a website's pages. It inspects the site as close as possible to what a human would see and then compares that with how LLMs interpret it, surfacing edge cases (such as div-based tables, or alt tags vs title tags) that cause ChatGPT and other models to misunderstand pages.
mentions.problem: There is a surprising amount of edge cases that can cause ChatGPT or others to misunderstand your pages — some models can handle div based tables, some want alt tags but cannot understand title tags, etc.
mentions.audience: Site owners and developers who want LLMs like ChatGPT to correctly understand their web pages.
